title: 第3733章 林傲风第3732章 气死你
slug: 邪鼎第3739章本祖是她的师尊
content_zh:
“你敢！”
天衍老祖怒目一瞪。
苏凡哼道：“那就等着瞧呗，看我敢不敢。”
天衍老祖无力地叹了口气：“随老夫去禁区。”
苏凡狐疑：“去禁区做什么？”
“废话。”
天衍老祖沉着脸：“当然是学炼丹。”
“不要。”
苏凡摇头。
天衍老祖怒吼：“你是不是要气死老夫？”
苏凡瘪着嘴：“我又没说要气你，是你自己要生气的。”
“你……”
“我……”
天衍老祖气得头顶冒烟，上气不接下气。
“师尊，别气别气。”
苏凡安抚，呲牙笑道：“答应弟子一件事，弟子就乖乖地和您老人家学炼丹。”
天衍老祖皱眉：“还讲条件？”
苏凡反问：“不能讲条件吗？”
“能！”
天衍老祖咬牙切齿：“说，什么事？”

苏凡道：“我们要去黄泉试炼。”
天衍老祖一愣。
端木老祖，承天老祖，总殿主，也不由看着苏凡和李有德等人，满脸意外。
天衍老祖回过神，皱眉道：“所以，你是为了黄泉试炼而来？”
苏凡点头。
天衍老祖又问：“那要是没有黄泉试炼，你是不是还要继续躲起来？”
“那当然，没有黄泉试炼，我来星辰殿干什么？”
苏凡刚说完，就发现天衍老祖脸色不对劲，急忙改口道：“不是不是，师尊，你听弟子狡辩，其实弟子早就想来星辰殿学炼丹，但没办法，这几年天天忙着修炼，实在抽不出时间。”
天衍老祖深深一叹。
收了这么一个弟子，还真是让人头疼啊！
苏凡谄笑：“师尊，你要相信弟子，所谓一日为师终生为父，弟子对您老人家的敬仰之情，犹如滔滔江水绵延不断……”
“打住！”
天衍老祖瞪了眼他，抬头揉着额头，转头看向总殿主：“他们要去黄泉试炼这事，你怎么看？”
“我当然赞同。”
“毕竟黄泉试炼是一个难得的机会，可以好好磨砺一下他们的心性。”
content_en:
"How dare you!"
Ancestor Tianyan glared angrily.
Su Fan hummed, "Then just wait and see if I dare."
Ancestor Tianyan sighed feebly: "Follow me to the restricted area."
Su Fan was confused: "What are you doing in the restricted area?"
"Bullshit."
Ancestor Tianyan said solemnly: "Of course I am learning to make alchemy."
"No."
Su Fan shook his head.
Ancestor Tianyan roared: "Are you going to piss me off to death?"
Su Fan pursed his lips: "I didn't say I wanted to make you angry. It's you who wants to be angry."
"You..."
"I..."
Ancestor Tianyan was so angry that smoke was rising from his head and he was out of breath.
"Master, don't be angry, don't be angry."
Su Fan comforted him and said with a grin: "Promise me one thing, and I will learn alchemy from you."
Ancestor Tianyan frowned: "Are you still talking about conditions?"
Su Fan asked back: "Can't we negotiate conditions?"
"Yes!"
Ancestor Tianyan gritted his teeth: "Tell me, what's the matter?"
Su Fan said: "We are going to Huangquan for trial."
Ancestor Tianyan was stunned.
Ancestor Duanmu, Ancestor Chengtian, and the master of the main hall could not help but look at Su Fan, Li Youde and others with surprise on their faces.
Ancestor Tianyan came back to his senses and frowned: "So, you are here for the Underworld Trial?"
Su Fan nodded.
Ancestor Tianyan asked again: "Then if there was no trial of Huangquan, would you still continue to hide?"
"Of course, without the Underworld Trial, what would I do in the Star Palace?"
As soon as Su Fan finished speaking, he noticed something was wrong with Patriarch Tianyan's face and hurriedly changed his words: "No, no, Master, listen to the disciple's quibbles. In fact, the disciple has long wanted to come to Xingchen Palace to learn alchemy, but there is no way. He has been busy practicing every day in the past few years and really can't spare the time."
Ancestor Tianyan sighed deeply.
Taking on such a disciple is really a headache!
Su Fan smiled flatteringly: "Master, you have to believe in this disciple. It is said that once a teacher is always a father, the respect that the disciples have for you is like the endless stream of a river..."
"Stop it!"
Ancestor Tianyan glared at him, raised his head and rubbed his forehead, then turned to look at the main hall master: "They are going to the underworld for a trial. What do you think?"
"Of course I agree."
"After all, the Underworld Trial is a rare opportunity to sharpen their character."
